summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 3 Admin Subscription Management. All 13 requested features verified working. Backend API: 14/14 tests passed. Frontend UI: All subscription management features functional.
passed_tests: GET /api/admin/subscriptions returns user list with subscription info, plan_counts, MRR stats
GET /api/admin/subscriptions?search=Athlete filters by search term (3 matching users)
PUT /api/admin/subscriptions/{user_id} changes user plan and creates audit log
GET /api/admin/subscription-logs returns recent subscription change audit logs
Admin Subscriptions page (/admin/subscriptions) loads with stats cards (MRR, total users, paid users, free users)
Admin Subscriptions page shows plan distribution bars (Basic, Pro, Premium with percentages)
Admin Subscriptions page shows user table with inline plan dropdowns
Changing a plan via inline dropdown and clicking check button updates the plan (tested Pro change)
Recent Changes audit log sidebar shows subscription change history with old_plan -> new_plan format
Subscriptions nav item is active (pink highlight) in admin sidebar
Admin Dashboard 'Manage Subscriptions' quick action navigates to /admin/subscriptions
Admin header shows 'Subscription Management' when on subscriptions page
Clicking user name in subscription table navigates to /admin/users/{userId}
test_credentials: No credentials needed - app is public with MOCKED auth (get_current_user returns static user)
seed_data_creation: Used existing test data - 14 users (12 basic, 1 pro, 1 premium), MRR $58
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 Admin Subscription Management fully verified. Key data-testid attributes: admin-subscriptions-page, sub-stat-monthly-revenue, sub-stat-total-users, sub-stat-paid-users, sub-stat-free-users, sub-users-table, sub-audit-log, sub-search, sub-plan-filter, inline-plan-select-{userId}, inline-plan-save-{userId}, sub-row-{userId}, sub-log-{logId}, admin-nav-subscriptions, admin-quick-manage-subscriptions. API endpoints: GET /api/admin/subscriptions (with ?plan=X and ?search=X filters), PUT /api/admin/subscriptions/{userId}, GET /api/admin/subscription-logs. MRR calculation: Pro*$19 + Premium*$39. Audit logs capture old_plan, new_plan, reason, changed_by, created_at.
